resources.string: Quire counts your reading from this version on, so there is no history from before. It is kept on this device and in your phone’s own backup, never sent to Quire’s server or to AI. Read a book for a few minutes and come back.
Recording is off. Turn on %1$s → %2$s to count your reading.
A day counts towards a streak with at least 5 minutes of reading.
Reading time per day over the past week: %1$s in total, most on %2$s with %3$s.
Reading time per day over the past 30 days: %1$s in total, most on %2$s with %3$s.
Reading time per month over the past year: %1$s in total, most in %2$s with %3$s.
Reading time by hour of day. Most between %1$s and %2$s, with %3$s.
Reading time by day of week. Most on %1$s, with %2$s.
Not enough reading yet to tell your speed.
Each book’s words are counted once, on this device. In Chinese and Japanese each character counts as a word.
This removes every reading session stored on this device. It can’t be undone.
Counts how long, when and how fast you read. Kept on this device and in your phone’s own backup, never sent to Quire’s server or to AI. See them in the library under %1$s → %2$s.
Recording has stopped. Keep the statistics already stored, or clear them?
Counted by your Quire server: every book in your library, on all your devices.
Share this phone’s existing and future reading activity with your Quire account.
Clear reading statistics from your Quire account and synced devices?
